meta.name: portfolio-strategy
meta.description: Decides where capital and attention go across business lines, products, and markets — what to fund, hold, harvest, or exit, and on what evidence. Use this to allocate budget across businesses, evaluate whether a product line should continue, decide whether to exit one, structure a portfolio review, or when several initiatives compete for the same limited investment.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 理清业务线投资优先级，决定追加还是退出
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果常要在多个业务或产品间分配预算，犹豫是否砍掉某个产品线
copy.tagline_en: Prioritize business lines and decide where to invest or exit.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often allocate budget across businesses and hesitate to cut a product line

howto.what: 它会用“市场吸引力”和“我们有没有胜算”两条标准，把每条业务线归成资助、持有、收获或退出，强制排序，并给出证据、分配建议、该停的事和能推翻判断的信号。
howto.when: 当你要求分配跨业务线预算、评估产品线去留，或做组合审查时触发。

say.text: 评估一下我们三条产品线，哪条该重点投入？
say.note: 输出各线姿态和投入建议

say.text: 我们该不该撤出这个市场？给个判断。
say.note: 用“现在还会开始吗”做前瞻测试

say.text: 做一次年度组合审查，列出各线证据和权重。

howto.what_en: It scores each line on market attractiveness and right to win, assigns a fund/hold/harvest/exit posture, forces ranking, and returns evidence, allocation advice, stop items, and reversal indicators.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to allocate budget across business lines, evaluate whether to continue or exit a product line, or structure a portfolio review.

say_en.text: Review our three product lines and tell me which one deserves more funding.
say_en.note: Outputs posture and supporting evidence for each.

say_en.text: Should we exit this market? Give me your judgment.
say_en.note: Applies the 'would we start today' prospective test.

say_en.text: Run an annual portfolio review with evidence and weights.
